requiredbulletpoints.bulletpoint: Lead and sole Unity engineer across 3 shipped projects (2 XR, 1 non-XR) within 13 months, delivering client applications, a commercial VR title (Monkey Tower), and a Meta Special Prize-winning mixed reality experience (Language IRL) under aggressive timelines.

bulletpoints.bulletpoint: Sole engineer on a large-format XR kiosk deployed at 4+ conventions (10+ live days), building a Unity application for continuous public use on a 72-inch touchscreen with fully turnkey operation and no on-site support.

Built an offline-capable Unity kiosk with 2 presentation modes and 20+ tracked interaction datapoints per session, logging to local CSV with Google Sheets sync. Reused across 4+ deployments with virtually no remote troubleshooting.

Delivered next-day feature updates and adapted to major scope shifts with 1–2 weeks’ notice. Progressed the system through prototype, initial build, and full refactor while adding crash recovery, management mode, and auto-reset for continuous operation.

Sole full-time engineer on Monkey Tower VR within a 2-person core team, shipping a paid VR title in 9 months with ~12 contracted contributors. Built 10 levels, 7 enemy types, single and multiplayer modes, 2 difficulty tiers, and a roguelite progression system.

Architected core systems including Photon P2P multiplayer, modular gameplay, and extensible progression. Hit Quest 2/3 performance targets and passed all Meta VRC checks without exception requests. Built Unity editor tools for non-engineer content creation.

Shipped Monkey Tower VR across Quest 3/3S, Quest 2/Pro, and PCVR via staggered releases, managing technical store submissions. Maintained weekly patches with zero crashes recorded in Meta telemetry and no emergency stability fixes.
Owned game architecture and integration, coordinating ~12 contracted contributors and serving as final authority on system integrity, performance, and build stability.

Implemented a fully data-driven architecture with performance-based star progression unlocking abilities and upgrades. Used ScriptableObjects and JSON procedural level definitions to enable content creation without core code changes.

Sole engineer on Language IRL, delivering a mixed reality AI language tutor in 4 weeks within a 2-person team. Extended and refactored early Quest passthrough examples into a competition-ready system.

Built an end-to-end MR AI tutoring pipeline integrating passthrough + YOLO object detection, LLM-assisted curriculum generation, spatial anchors, and Azure speech recognition, TTS, and pronunciation grading with real-time local processing.
Used Quest 3 passthrough and spatial APIs to anchor exercises to real-world objects, adapting UI to partially documented platform components under strict deadlines.
Implemented safeguards to validate and filter LLM-generated lesson content, preventing inappropriate outputs while maintaining context-appropriate language experiences.
Language IRL was named one of three winners of Meta’s $50,000 Best Implementation of Passthrough Camera Access (PCA) with AI award.
Built and maintained a shared Unity utility library across all HowellXR projects, centralizing logging and editor tooling to reduce duplicate code and improve workflow consistency.
